title: Eclipse
content: So the eclipse is happening today and it reminded me of 2 months ago maybe 1 and a half but there was an eclipse in my mall world except it was by far way closer and much larger I don’t know what that means I just remember the day it happened and weirdly enough I remembered seeing the pope in the same building I was in looking really angry yelling at ppl idk it was a weird dream just was weird because I’ve never dreamt of an eclipse or even knew one was happening this year
